headline: DeepSeek's newer flash model hits 9.8% share in just 2 days
summary: DeepSeek/deepseek-v4-flash-20260731 vaulted from nowhere to rank 2 with 9.8% token share, extending its streak to day 2—a remarkable debut. Meanwhile, OpenAI's gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 keeps climbing the charts on day 4 of its all-time high run at 8.4% share. Two OpenAI models dropped out entirely, while Qwen and a fresh OpenAI entry joined the rankings.
highlights: DeepSeek's v4-flash-20260731 jumped 3 ranks to #2 with 9.8% share (day 2 of record streak)
OpenAI's gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 holding strong at 8.4% share (day 4 of all-time high)
DeepSeek provider share surged 1.8% in one day, now at 25.5% overall
OpenAI's gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07 and gpt-5.4-mini-20260317 both dropped out
Qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b and OpenAI/gpt-5.4-20260305 entered the rankings
